name: joplin-search-match-count
description: Shows the number of search matches (e.g. 3/17) in the Markdown editor's search panel.

scripts.dist: webpack --env joplin-plugin-config=buildMain && webpack --env joplin-plugin-config=buildExtraScripts && webpack --env joplin-plugin-config=createArchive
scripts.update: npm install -g generator-joplin && yo joplin --node-package-manager npm --update --force
scripts.test: tsc src/countMatches.ts --outDir dist-test --module commonjs --target es2018 --skipLibCheck --moduleResolution node && node test/countMatches.test.js
